svg.title: What you pay for
svg.desc: The app is free. It runs on a laptop or on dedicated machines on the local network, one hub or several. The cloud bucket is in your name and you pay the storage vendor. Help is optional: we can bring a machine and set up a hub, or we run the cloud account while you keep the bucket. Service prices are not listed yet.
svg.text: Free. Use it without paying us.
On your laptop, or on dedicated machines.
One local hub, or several. It still runs if you stop hiring us.
Yours. You pay the storage vendor.
About $1 per terabyte a month for files you rarely open.
Hotter storage costs more. The account stays in your name.
We set it up. The bucket stays yours.
We can bring a hub, or set up machines you already have.
Or we run the cloud account. You still own the bucket.
Those service prices are not listed on this page yet.
